name_in_paper: serological testing for hepatitis B, hepatitis C and HIV

evidence.quote: Enrolled subjects were in good health, had normal baseline haematology and biochemistry, and negative serological testing for hepatitis B, hepatitis C and HIV.

name_in_paper: ex vivo ELISpot response to ESAT-6 and CFP-10 peptides

evidence.quote: Latent infection with M. tb was excluded by means of a negative ex vivo ELISpot response to ESAT-6 and CFP-10 peptides.
Routine laboratory biochemical and haematological parameters were measured at 7 and 84 days post-vaccination.

The secondary endpoint was the immunogenicity of MVA85A measured by the ex vivo interferon-gamma (IFNγ) ELISpot assay performed on fresh peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) stimulated with pools of mycobacterial peptides.
Exploratory pre-defined immunological analyses included multi-parameter flow cytometry as detailed below.

name_in_paper: surface staining for chemokine receptors CCR4, CCR6, CCR7 and CXCR3

evidence.quote: To assess the effect of vaccination route on cell trafficking we measured the expression of chemokine receptors by surface staining PBMC for 30 min at 37 °C with CCR4/PERCPCY5.5, CCR6/AF647 (Biolegend), CCR7/PECY7 and CXCR3/PECY5 (BD Bioscience) (clones TG6/CCR4, TG7/CCR6, 3D12 and 1C6/CXCR3 respectively).
